name: Soft Shadow Visibility with Dithered Penumbra
definition: Calculates soft shadow visibility (0..1) towards the sun by marching along the sun direction, using a dithered rotation of the sun vector per pixel to create a penumbra that averages out with supersampling.
summary: Soft Shadow Visibility with Dithered Penumbra calculates soft shadow visibility by normalizing the penumbra calculation by t multiplied by sunY rather than distance alone, preventing false heavy shadows on flat ground.
